spans.s:
लुण्ट् लुण्ट् [cf. rts. रुण्ट्, रुण्ठ्, 1. लुठ्,
लुण्ड्], cl. 1. P. लुण्टति, &c., to rob,
plunder; cl. 10. P. लुण्टयति, &c., to rob, plunder;
to peel, (for rt. लुञ्च्); to disregard, despise.
लुण्टक, अस्, m. a kind of vegetable; a proper N.
लुण्टाक, अस्, m. a robber, thief; a crow.
लुण्टा, f. robbing; rolling, (for लुठन, q. v.)

लुण्टित, अस्, आ, अम्, robbed, plundered; peeled,
(for लुञ्चित.)

लुण्ठ् लुण्ठ् (= rt. रुण्ठ्), cl. 1. P. लुण्-
ठति, &c., to go; to stir up, agitate,
excite, set in motion (= rts. 2. लुठ्, लुड्); to be
idle; to be lame; to repel, resist; to steal, rob,
plunder, pillage [cf. rts. रुण्ट्, लुण्ट्, 1. लुठ्]: Caus.
लुण्ठयति, to rob, steal, plunder, sack; to peel,
(for rt. लुञ्च्.)
लुण्ठक, अस्, m. a robber, plunderer.
लुण्ठाक, अस्, m. a robber; a crow.

लुण्ठत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, stirring up, exciting, agi-
tating; rolling, (for लुठत्.)
लुण्ठन, अम्, n. the act of plundering, pillaging.
लुण्ठ-नदी, f., N. of a river.
लुण्ठयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, plundering, pillaging.

लुण्ठा, f. robbing, pillaging, &c.; rolling, &c.,
(for लुठन, q. v.)
लुण्ठि, इस्, f. plundering, pillaging, sacking.
लुण्ठी, f. = लुठन, q. v.

लुण्ठित, अस्, आ, अम्, plundered, pillaged, robbed,
stolen; peeled, (for लुञ्चित.)

लुण्ड् लुण्ड् (= rts. रुण्ट्, लुण्ट्, 1. लुठ्),
cl. 1. 10. P. लुण्डति, लुण्डयति, &c.,
to rob, plunder.

लुण्डिका लुण्डिका, f. a ball, round mass
(of anything); proper behaviour, fitting conduct.

लुण्डी, f. proper behaviour, becoming conduct,
acting and judging rightly.

लुण्डी-कृ, cl. 8. P. -करोति, &c., to roll into a
ball, roll up, roll together.
—लुण्डी-कृत, अस्, आ,
अम्, made into a ball, rolled up together.
